name: Return to the Crossroads.
summary: Gryshka's reply is on its way from Orgrimmar to Zargh at the Crossroads. A wind rider carries it across the distance between Durotar and the Barrens.

sections.title: A Winged Return
sections.body: You carry Gryshka's written reply to Zargh after bringing her a parcel of prime meat in Orgrimmar. Doras, the wind rider master atop Orgrimmar's high bluffs, provides a mount for the return to the Barrens. You have already met Devrak at the Crossroads, so the wyverns know the flight path. The ride crosses the desert sky and saves you the long march overland across the Southfury River.

sections.title: A Match Made in the Barrens
sections.body: Zargh's courtship has won Gryshka's warm reply. Quality provisions have pleased her, and Zargh celebrates, even musing about an impending wedding. The delivery also brings you back to the Barrens' central hub for travel.

faq.q: Why do I have to use a wind rider to return?
faq.answer: Doras sends you by wind rider because you have already visited Devrak at the Crossroads. The wyverns can fly between the two roosts, saving time and keeping supply lines secure.
Gryshka is the innkeeper in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength. Zargh sent her choice Barrens meat in hopes of winning her favor.

faq.q: What was Zargh's goal in sending meat to Orgrimmar?
faq.answer: Zargh sent meat to court Gryshka. Among orcs, a gift of hearty, quality game from the Barrens is a grand romantic gesture.
You return to Zargh at the Crossroads in the Barrens, near the watchtower and stables, and hand back Gryshka's Letter.
Doras is the wind rider master at the flight roost above Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength. He manages the aerial mounts that travel across Kalimdor.
You finish the Meats to Orgrimmar courier chain. Orgrimmar and the Crossroads are connected, and the Barrens lies open for further travel.

angles.text: Orgrimmar's and the Crossroads' wind rider roosts link the Horde capital to Kalimdor's perilous plains, carrying trade and supplies between them.
As an orc, you know that hearty cuts of fresh game are among the finest gifts of affection and respect for a prospective mate.
